messages:
maria_cs: Quick check-in — Ignite just rotated keys and now their Node SDK calls are getting 403s. Happening right after we set NEW_API_KEY in their k8s secret. anyone free?
ignite-eng: yep seeing 403s in prod logs. error body: `{"error":"invalid_scope","message":"missing:chat.write"}`. No other traffic changes.
sam_se: thanks. two quick things: 1) confirm the key value format (no extra quotes/newlines), 2) confirm the key was created with the right scopes for the env (chat + embeddings).
ignite-eng: they generated the key via UI and pasted into secret. i copied directly from download file. looks fine at a glance.
leo_devx: can you paste the exact header and a minimal repro curl (redact key)? usually rotation issues are either a partial newline or using the client-side ephemeral token endpoint incorrectly.
ignite-eng: curl like: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","input":"hi"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate
```
response 403 body above.
sam_se: ok that looks right. @leo_devx — quick thought: we had a recent change where UI-exported keys include a trailing newline in some browsers. If their k8s secret contains that newline the API accepts it but scope parsing fails -> invalid_scope. can you check secret value length?
leo_devx: asked Ignite to `kubectl get secret ignite-api -o go-template='{{index .data "key"}}' | base64 -d | od -An -t c` to reveal control chars. they returned "rKk...\n" so there is a trailing newline.
maria_cs: oh nice catch. so fix is to strip newline at creation or use `tr -d '\n'` when injecting. should we also patch the SDK to trim keys on init?
sam_se: yes, SDK change is low-risk: `const key = (process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || '').trim()` and echo in logs in masked form for onboarding. we'll ship in next devx patch.
ignite-eng: removed newline from secret and restarted pods — traffic looks green, 200 responses now. thanks! :tada:
onboard-bot: note created: ticket CS-2189 for SDK key-trim change and docs note about key copy/paste gotchas.
maria_cs: added this as an onboarding checklist item for customers who rotate keys. also leaving a tip in the quickstart about `kubectl create secret generic --from-literal=REDWOOD_API_KEY="$KEY"` vs piping raw files.
leo_devx: one more: we saw a short burst of 429s during the restart (their deployment used aggressive parallelism). recommend we add a note to use gradual restarts or set concurrency limiter in SDK.
sam_se: good call. will add a small paragraph on restart concurrency + a sample `maxConcurrentRequests: 8` config.
maria_cs: closing for now — feel free to reopen if anything else crops up.
